evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/lib/api.ts:371 — `export default getApiClient()` is evaluated at module-load time, before AuthProvider runs configureApiClient(). At that point apiInstance is null, so getApiClient() builds an UNCONFIGURED axios instance (no getToken request interceptor => no Authorization header; no onUnauthorized handler => no single-flight 401 refresh-and-replay) and binds it as the default export. configureApiClient() later reassigns the `apiInstance` singleton, but the already-evaluated default export keeps its reference to the pre-config instance forever. Consequence: any consumer that does `import api from '@/lib/api'` (default import) gets a client that sends no auth header and never refreshes tokens — silent auth failure. Latent today (all current consumers use the named getApiClient(): features/predictive-maintenance, features/sentiment, routes/groups/person-months.tsx), so severity=low, but it is a footgun that will silently break auth the first time someone default-imports. Fix: remove the default export, or replace it with a lazy getter / Proxy that forwards to the live getApiClient() singleton.
